readExpr: [...document.querySelectorAll('aside.pca-sidebar a[href*="server"]')].map(a => a.getAttribute('href') + ' :: mine=' + a.textContent.includes('本地') + ' :: active=' + a.classList.contains('active')).join('  ||  ')
(() => { const act = document.querySelector('aside.pca-sidebar a.active'); return act ? (act.getAttribute('href') + ' :: mine=' + act.textContent.includes('本地')) : 'no active link'; })()
